en: A black-and-white view of a small village nestled in a wooded valley. Traditional half-timbered houses and other rural buildings are scattered among trees and gardens. On the right side stands a prominent church with a tall spire and a smaller chapel-like building in front, both surrounded by what appears to be a churchyard or cemetery. Behind the village rises a densely forested hillside. At the bottom margin, there is a caption in German in a decorative script.
